terms.s2P2: You fit get one account only. If you create plenty accounts to cheat, dem go permanently ban you.

terms.s3P2: If you feel say person don enter your account, contact us sharp sharp for <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>.

terms.s4P2: Paystack dey process entry fee safely. We no dey keep your card details.
terms.s4P3: You fit use SX Coins to reduce or waive entry fee where dem allow am. Check our Refund Policy to see how cancellation dey work.
terms.s5Intro: Every player must play straight. Dis ones no dey allowed:
terms.s5List:
• To submit fake or manipulated match result
  • To use outside tools, scripts, or exploit to get advantage
  • To gang up with your opponent to fix result
  • To threaten, harass, or abuse your opponent
terms.s5P2: You must submit match result with evidence (screenshot and screen recording). Wetin admin decide for disputed result, na im be final.
terms.s5P3: No-show — wey mean say you no show up for your match without notice — go make you forfeit and lose SX Score.
terms.s6P1: Prize money dey enter di bank account wey you link to your player dashboard through Paystack. You must complete identity verification before your first withdrawal.
terms.s6P2: We dey try process approved withdrawal within 1–5 business days. If your bank delay am, na dem cause am, no be us.
terms.s7P1: SX Coins na virtual currency wey dey inside di platform. You go earn am as you dey play and spend time for di platform. SX Coins no get any cash value and you no fit change am to money. You fit use am inside di platform for entry fee discount, community features, and di in-platform store.
terms.s8P1: Gaming Exchange (wey Zolarux escrow dey power) make players fit buy and sell gaming accounts and in-game items. SentinelX dey provide di platform and escrow infrastructure. We no be part of di transaction between buyer and seller and we no dey responsible for any dispute wey come from transaction wey happen outside di platform escrow system.
terms.s9P1: You agree to respect every other member of SentinelX community. Hate speech, discrimination, threat, and harassment no get space here — e go cause suspension or permanent ban. Check our Community Rules to see di full standards.
terms.s10P1: All SentinelX branding, design, and original content na SentinelX Esports property. You no fit copy or share our content without written permission. Content wey you post (match screenshots, community posts) still remain yours, but you dey give us licence to show am for di platform.
terms.s11P1: SentinelX Esports no dey liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential loss wey come from how you dey use di platform. Di total wey we fit owe you for any claim no go pass di total entry fee wey you don pay us for di last 3 months before di claim.
terms.s11P2: We no dey guarantee say platform go dey up 24/7. We go try our best to restore service quick quick if downtime happen.
terms.s12P1: We fit update dis Terms anytime. We go notify you through di platform or email if any major change happen. If you still dey use SentinelX after we post di changes, e mean say you don accept di new terms.
terms.s13P1: Dis Terms dey follow di law of Federal Republic of Nigeria. Any dispute go dey under Nigerian court jurisdiction.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Last update: August 2026 · E dey follow Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA)
privacy.metaDescription: How SentinelX Esports dey collect, use, and protect your personal data under Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.
privacy.s1P1: SentinelX Esports, wey Samuel Chinoyerem Akpoke dey run, na di data controller for personal information wey dis platform dey collect. Contact: <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>.
privacy.s2AccountList:
• Email address
  • Username and display name
  • Country
  • Password (we dey store am as secure hash — we never see your real password)
privacy.s2ProfileList:
• WhatsApp phone number (optional — we dey use am only for match notification if you opt in)
  • Profile photo
  • Bio
privacy.s2TournamentList:
• Payment information (Paystack dey process am — we dey receive transaction reference, no be your card details)
  • Bank account details (Paystack dey collect am for prize withdrawal — Paystack dey store am, no be us)
privacy.s2PlayList:
• Match history, score, and result
  • SX Score and ranking
  • Achievement and SX Coins balance
  • Match screenshot and recording wey you submit for result verification
privacy.s2AutoList:
• Log data (IP address, browser type, pages wey you visit) — we dey use am for security and to fix bugs
  • Session cookies (na im make login work)
privacy.s3Heading: 3. Why We Dey Use Your Data

account.purpose: To run your account and di platform

whatsapp.basis: Consent — you opt in wen you add your phone number

privacy.s4Heading: 4. Who We Dey Share Your Data With
privacy.s4Intro: We only dey share data where e necessary:
privacy.s4List:
• Paystack — payment processing and bank account verification for prize payout
  • Supabase — database and authentication infrastructure (servers fit dey outside Nigeria; Supabase Inc. dey follow correct data transfer safeguard)
  • Vercel — web hosting
  • Termii (wen e dey active) — WhatsApp notification delivery, only for players wey add phone number
  • Firebase / Google — push notification delivery (FCM)
privacy.s4P2: We no dey sell your personal data. We no dey share am with advertisers.
privacy.s4P3: We fit disclose data to Nigerian law enforcement or regulatory bodies if law require am.
privacy.s5P1: Your username, display name, country, profile photo, SX Score, match history, and achievement dey visible to everybody wey visit di platform. Dis one necessary because of how di platform competitive and community nature be. You fit update your display name and photo anytime for Settings.
privacy.s6Intro: As data subject, you get right to:
privacy.s6List:
• Access — ask for copy of di personal data wey we hold about you
  • Rectification — ask us to correct wrong data
  • Erasure — ask us to delete your account and personal data
  • Restriction — ask us to limit how we dey process your data
  • Portability — collect your data for structured, machine-readable format
  • Objection — object to processing wey dey based on legitimate interest
  • Withdraw consent — remove your WhatsApp number or turn off notification anytime for Settings
privacy.s6P2: To use any of dis rights, email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>. We go respond within 30 days.
privacy.s6P3: You still get right to file complaint with Nigeria Data Protection Commission (NDPC) for <link>ndpc.gov.ng</link>.
privacy.s7P1: We dey keep your account data as long as your account still active. If you delete your account, we go erase your personal data within 30 days, except law force us to keep am (example, payment records fit stay till 7 years for tax and financial compliance).
privacy.s7P2: Match records and results fit remain for anonymised form for platform statistics.
privacy.s8P1: We dey use industry-standard security measures like encrypted connection (HTTPS), hashed password, and role-based access control. No system dey perfectly secure — if you feel say person don enter your account, contact us sharp sharp.
privacy.s9P1: Players wey no reach 18 fit use di platform if their parent consent. We no dey knowingly collect data from children wey no reach 13. If we notice say child wey no reach 13 create account, we go delete am.
privacy.s10P1: We go notify you through di platform or email if we make any major change to dis policy. Di latest version dey always available for sentinelxesports.com/privacy.

refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.subtitle: Last update: August 2026
refundPolicy.metaDescription: Wen tournament entry fee, coin discount, and prize money fit refund and wen dem no fit refund.
refundPolicy.s1P1: Entry fee no dey refundable once dem confam your registration and tournament don start.
refundPolicy.s1RefundIntro: You go get full refund if:
refundPolicy.s1RefundList:
• SentinelX cancel di tournament before e start
  • Admin reject your registration before dem publish di bracket
  • Technical error for our platform stop you from playing
refundPolicy.s1NoRefundIntro: You no go get refund if:
refundPolicy.s1NoRefundList:
• You no-show for your scheduled match
  • Dem disqualify you for rule violation after tournament don start
  • You change your mind after dem publish di bracket
refundPolicy.s1P2: Refund dey process through di original payment method and e dey normally take 3–7 business days to show.
refundPolicy.s2Heading: Entry Fee Discount Wey Use SX Coins
refundPolicy.s2Intro: If you use SX Coins to reduce or waive your entry fee:
refundPolicy.s2List:
• Di coin portion go refund as coins (no be naira) if qualifying cancellation happen
  • Coins go enter back your balance immediately after refund
refundPolicy.s3P1: Prize money dey enter your linked bank account after admin approve am. Once dem approve am, payout no fit reverse. If you feel say dem calculate prize wrong, contact us within 7 days after dem confam di result.
refundPolicy.s4P1: SX Coins na virtual currency wey you dey earn through platform activity. Dem no get cash value and dem no dey refundable. If dem close your account because of serious rule violation, you go lose your coins.
refundPolicy.s5P1: Email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email> with your username, tournament name, and di reason for your request. We go respond within 3 business days.

rules.title: Tournament Rules
rules.metaDescription: Eligibility, match, result-submission, dispute, and conduct rules wey apply to every SentinelX tournament.
rules.eligibilityList:
• You must get registered and verified SentinelX account
  • You must pay entry fee (₦500 or reduced with SX Coins) before registration deadline
  • Players wey dey serve active suspension no fit enter
rules.beforeList:
• Registration go close before dem generate di bracket — you no fit register after deadline
  • Check your fixture (your scheduled match) for your Player Dashboard after dem publish di bracket
  • Dey online and ready 15 minutes before your scheduled match time
rules.playingList:
• Matches dey play on di agreed game and platform (DLS, EA FC Mobile, eFootball, etc.) as e dey inside di tournament details
  • Both players must enter di match lobby at di scheduled time
  • If you no fit find your opponent after you wait 10 minutes from di scheduled start time, screenshot di empty lobby and submit am as no-show report
rules.submittingList:
• Na di winner get responsibility to submit di result
  • Submit screenshot of di final scoreline AND screen recording of di match
  • You must submit result within 2 hours after di match don end
  • Admin go review and confam di result — di bracket go update only after confam
rules.noShowList:
• If you no show up for your scheduled match, na no-show
  • No-show: your opponent go advance automatically, and you go lose 100 SX Score points
  • If you keep no-show, dem fit suspend you from future tournaments
rules.disputesList:
• If di submitted result wrong, di player wey lose fit raise dispute within 1 hour after submission
  • Admin go review both players' screen recording and take final decision
  • Wetin admin decide for dispute, na im be final
  • If you raise false dispute (wen you dey deliberately contest correct result), you go get SX Score penalty
rules.conductList:
• Respect your opponent — harassment, hate speech, or threat go cause immediate disqualification and suspension
  • Match fixing or collusion na permanent ban offence
  • To use game exploits or outside tools na permanent ban offence
rules.prizesList:
• Prize dey enter di winner wallet after admin confam di final result
  • Players must complete KYC verification before dem withdraw prize money
  • Withdrawal request dey process within 1–5 business days

communityRules.title: Community Rules
communityRules.metaDescription: Di standards wey dey keep SentinelX community positive, competitive, and safe.
communityRules.intro: SentinelX na Nigeria home of mobile esports. Di community na for everybody wey love di game — we dey keep am positive, competitive, and safe.
communityRules.basicP1: Treat every member di way wey you go want dem treat you for tournament in person. Behind every username, na real person dey.
communityRules.harassmentP1: No insult, threat, or discrimination based on tribe, religion, gender, region, or any other personal characteristic. Dis one include DMs.
communityRules.spamP1: No repeated posting of di same content, no promotional links without permission, no bot activity.
communityRules.falseInfoP1: No post fake match result, fake screenshot, or misleading claim about other players.
communityRules.privacyP1: No share another player personal information (phone number, address, real name if dem dey use username) without dem consent.
communityRules.cheatingP1: No share or promote methods for cheating for any game wey di platform support.
communityRules.nsfwP1: No explicit, violent, or disturbing content of any kind.
communityRules.consequencesP1:
First offence: Warning
Second offence: Temporary suspension (7–30 days depending on how bad e be)
Serious offences (hate speech, threat, doxxing, cheating): Immediate suspension or permanent ban, no warning need
communityRules.reportingP1: You see something wey break dis rules? Use di report button for any post, or email <email>sentinelxesports@gmail.com</email>. Admin team dey review reports. We dey take every report serious.

safety.title: Stay Safe for SentinelX
safety.metaDescription: How to protect your account, your prize money, and yourself as you dey trade or play for SentinelX.
safety.protectAccountList:
• Use strong, unique password for SentinelX — no reuse am from another app
  • No share your password with anybody, even person wey claim say na SentinelX staff
  • Log out for shared devices after you finish play
  • If your email get reset request wey you no make, change your password sharp sharp and contact us
safety.neverAskHeading: We No Go Ever Ask You For Dis
safety.neverAskIntro: SentinelX staff no go ever ask you for your:
safety.neverAskList:
• Password
  • Bank account PIN or BVN
  • Paystack OTP codes
  • Payment to “unlock” prize money
safety.neverAskP2: If anybody wey claim say na SentinelX ask you for any of dis ones, na scam. Report am to us sharp sharp.
safety.protectPrizeList:
• Only link your own bank account for withdrawal
  • Verify your account before your first withdrawal — dis one dey protect you
  • Prize withdrawal na only through platform dashboard e dey go. Anybody wey ask you to send money first to “unlock” winnings na scammer
safety.safeTradingHeading: How to Trade Safe for Exchange
safety.safeTradingList:
• Always use Zolarux Escrow system for every trade. Money wey dey inside escrow dey protected until both parties confam di transaction
  • No ever agree to complete trade outside di platform — if buyer or seller ask you to go outside escrow, refuse am and report am
  • If deal too sweet to be true, e probably no be true
safety.matchSafetyList:
• Record your screen for every match — dis na your protection if dispute happen for result
  • Keep your recordings until after dem officially confam di result for di platform
  • If your opponent dey abuse you or threaten you, screenshot am and report through di platform or email us

escrow.title: Trade Safe with Zolarux Escrow
escrow.metaDescription: How Zolarux Escrow dey protect buyers and sellers for SentinelX Gaming Exchange.
escrow.whatIsExchangeP1: Gaming Exchange na SentinelX marketplace for gaming accounts, in-game items, and digital gaming assets. Dem build am for Nigerian mobile gamers wey wan buy and sell safe — without any risk of scam.
escrow.whatIsExchangeP2: Every transaction for di Exchange dey protected by Zolarux Escrow. <link>Browse di Exchange →</link>
escrow.whatIsEscrowP1: Zolarux na independent escrow service. Escrow mean say trusted third party go hold payment until both sides of transaction satisfy. Buyer money and seller item no go transfer until dem confam say deal don complete.
escrow.whatIsEscrowP2: Dis one dey protect both parties.
escrow.buyerList:
• You find item wey you want and you agree price
  • You send payment to Zolarux (no be straight to seller)
  • Seller deliver di item or account
  • You confam say you don receive am and e match di description
  • Zolarux release di payment go seller
escrow.buyerP2: If dem no deliver di item or dem misrepresent am, you fit raise dispute and dem go return your money.
escrow.sellerList:
• You list your item for di Exchange
  • Buyer buy am — their payment go to Zolarux, e never reach you yet
  • You deliver di item or transfer di account
  • Buyer confam say dem don receive am
  • Zolarux release your payment
escrow.sellerP2: You go only deliver once dem confam say buyer payment don enter escrow.
escrow.whyNotDirectHeading: Why You No Suppose Trade Direct
escrow.whyNotDirectP1: To trade outside escrow — whether through WhatsApp, direct transfer, or any other method — no dey protected. SentinelX no fit help you recover money or items wey you lose for trade wey happen outside di platform escrow system.
escrow.whyNotDirectP2: If buyer or seller ask you to complete trade outside escrow system, refuse am and report am.

tournamentGuide.title: Tournament Guide
tournamentGuide.subtitle: Everything wey you need to know.
tournamentGuide.metaDescription: Everything wey you need to know before, during, and after SentinelX tournament match.
tournamentGuide.checkGameP: Every tournament dey specify which game dem dey play. Make sure say you don install am and your in-game account dey ready.
tournamentGuide.checkFormatP: Tournaments dey use group stages (for big number of players) then single-elimination knockout rounds follow. Di tournament page go show how many groups, how many go advance, and di prize structure.
tournamentGuide.checkScheduleP: Tournaments get registration deadline and start date. Once registration close, dem go generate di bracket and no late entry dey accepted.
tournamentGuide.checkBalanceP: Entry fee na ₦500. If you no get enough SX Coins for discount, make sure say your card dey ready for Paystack payment.
tournamentGuide.registeringList:
• Go Tournaments → find open tournament → click Register
  • Choose your coin discount option (if e dey available)
  • Complete payment through Paystack (or confam free entry if you dey use full coin discount)
  • You go receive WhatsApp confirmation if you save number for Settings
tournamentGuide.afterRegP1: Your fixture go show for Dashboard → My Matches once dem publish di bracket. Dis one go show you who you dey play, wetin time, and wetin round.
tournamentGuide.afterRegP2: Set reminder. SentinelX go send WhatsApp reminder 1 hour before your match if notification don enable.
tournamentGuide.prepareP: If your internet no steady, na your own wahala — connection issue during match no be ground to reverse result.
tournamentGuide.recordP: Go your phone screen recorder and start am before you enter di game lobby. Dis recording na your evidence if dispute ever happen for result.
tournamentGuide.joinP: If you no fit find your opponent 10 minutes after di scheduled start, screenshot di empty lobby and report am as no-show.
tournamentGuide.playP: No exploits, no rage quit, no abuse.
tournamentGuide.submittingIntro: Na di winner dey submit di result — no be di loser.
tournamentGuide.submittingList:
• Go Dashboard → My Matches → di match → Submit Result
  • Upload your screenshot (final scoreline must dey clearly visible)
  • Upload your screen recording
  • Click Submit
tournamentGuide.submittingP2: You get 2 hours from wen match end to submit. After dat, if you no submit, dem fit treat am as no-show.
tournamentGuide.afterSubmissionP1: Admin go review your submission. If di result clean, dem go confam am within 24 hours and di bracket go update. Di loser get 1 hour after submission to raise dispute if dem feel say di result wrong.
tournamentGuide.afterSubmissionP2: If you win prize, e go show for your wallet after dem confam di final result.
tournamentGuide.tipsList:
• Keep all your recordings until after official confirmation — you fit need am for dispute
  • If you lose, no quit di app for middle of match — to abandon count against your SX Score
  • Good sportsmanship for di community, people go notice am. Your reputation matter pass just your score

tournamentFaqs.title: Tournament FAQs
tournamentFaqs.metaDescription: Answers to di most common questions about entering, playing, and getting paid from SentinelX tournaments.
tournamentFaqs.q1: I fit enter more than one tournament di same time?
tournamentFaqs.a1: Yes. You fit register for many active tournaments at di same time.
tournamentFaqs.a2: DLS (Dream League Soccer) na di current primary game. EA FC Mobile, eFootball, PUBG Mobile, Free Fire, Call of Duty Mobile, and Mortal Kombat dey come for future update.
tournamentFaqs.q3: How dem dey decide groups and brackets?
tournamentFaqs.a3: Wen registration close, system go automatically generate groups based on how many players register. Admin fit review and adjust am before dem publish am. Di bracket go then be single-elimination from group stage go forward.
tournamentFaqs.q4: Wetin if I need to withdraw from tournament after I don register?
tournamentFaqs.a4: Withdrawal after registration close no dey eligible for refund unless SentinelX cancel di tournament. If you sabi say you no fit play early early, contact us as soon as possible.
tournamentFaqs.q5: I fit play from any device?
tournamentFaqs.a5: Yes, as long as di required game don install and you fit maintain steady connection. All di games wey we support na mobile titles — PC or console play no dey applicable.
tournamentFaqs.q6: Wetin dem dey count as no-show?
tournamentFaqs.a6: If you no show for di game lobby within 10 minutes after di scheduled match start time. If you dey run late, message your opponent through di platform sharp sharp.
tournamentFaqs.q7: I fit play match early if both players agree?
tournamentFaqs.a7: No. Matches must play for di scheduled time to keep bracket integrity. Contact admin if both of una need to reschedule — admin fit approve am if dem want.
tournamentFaqs.q8: Wetin if I lose internet during match?
tournamentFaqs.a8: If connection lost during match, e no be ground to reverse result or replay am. If you disconnect during match and your opponent fit prove say match don complete, di result go stand.
tournamentFaqs.q9: How long tournament prizes dey stay before dem expire?
tournamentFaqs.a9: Prize money no dey expire — e go stay for your wallet until you withdraw am. Make sure your bank account don link and verify before you withdraw.
tournamentFaqs.q10: I win but dem never confam my result — wetin I go do?
tournamentFaqs.a10: First, check say you submit within 2 hours with both screenshot and recording. If you don do am and e don pass 24 hours without update, contact admin for sentinelxesports@gmail.com.

contact.subtitle: Wheda you get question about tournament, problem with your account, or something else — we dey reachable and we dey respond.

help.title: Help Center
help.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about accounts, tournaments, prizes, SX Score, and SX Coins.

gettingStarted.heading: How to Start
gettingStarted.a1: Click "Sign Up" for di homepage. Enter your email address and choose username. Verify your email using di link wey we send you, then complete your profile.
gettingStarted.a2: Yes, but once only. Go Settings to make di change. After dat, your username go lock — contact support if you get serious reason to change am again.
gettingStarted.a3: To create account and browse di platform, e free. To enter tournament cost ₦500 per tournament, or you fit use SX Coins wey you don earn to reduce or waive di fee.

tournaments.heading: Tournaments
tournaments.q1: How I go register for tournament?
tournaments.a1: Go Tournaments page, find open tournament, and click "Register." Dem go take you to payment screen. Complete your ₦500 payment through Paystack to confam your spot.
tournaments.q2: Wetin happen if I miss my match?
tournaments.a2: No-show mean say your opponent go advance automatically and you go lose 100 SX Score points. Always check your fixture for your Player Dashboard and set reminder.
tournaments.q3: How I go submit match result?
tournaments.a3: Go Dashboard → My Matches → Submit Result. Upload screenshot of di final scoreline and screen recording of di match. You need both of dem.
tournaments.q4: Wetin if my opponent submit wrong result?
tournaments.a4: You fit dispute di result within 1 hour after submission. Go di match page and click "Dispute." Admin go review both players recordings and take final decision.
tournaments.q5: How long e go take before dem confam result?
tournaments.a5: Admin dey aim to confam results within 24 hours after submission. Complex disputes fit take longer.
tournaments.a6: You go receive full refund to your original payment method within 3–7 business days.

prizes.heading: Prizes and Payments
prizes.q1: How I go withdraw my prize money?
prizes.a1: Go Dashboard → Wallet → Withdraw. Link your Nigerian bank account (first time only), enter di amount, and submit withdrawal request. We go process am within 1–5 business days.
prizes.q3: Why I need verify my identity before I withdraw?
prizes.a3: We dey verify your bank account through Paystack make sure say prize money reach di correct person and to comply with Nigerian financial regulations.
prizes.q4: Wen I go receive my withdrawal?
prizes.a4: Normally 1–5 business days after dem approve your request. Delay fit happen because of your bank processing time, wey no dey under our control.

sxScore.heading: SX Score
sxScore.a1: SX Score na your reliability and fair-play rating for di platform. Every player start with 700. E go increase wen you win and behave well, e go reduce wen you no-show, cheat, or lose dispute.
sxScore.a2: 900 and above: Elite (🟢). 750–899: Trusted (🔵). 600–749: Developing (🟡). Below 600: At Risk (🔴).
sxScore.a3: Yes. E no get floor cap — you fit always earn your way back up if you compete fair.

sxCoins.heading: SX Coins
sxCoins.a1: SX Coins na in-platform virtual currency. You go earn am as you compete, complete challenges, and unlock achievements.
sxCoins.q2: I fit convert SX Coins to naira?
sxCoins.a2: No. SX Coins na virtual and you no fit exchange am for cash. You fit only spend am inside di platform.
sxCoins.q3: Wetin I fit spend SX Coins on?
sxCoins.a3: Tournament entry fee discount (500 coins = ₦250 off, 1,000 coins = free entry), post boosts for di community, and items for di in-platform store.

accountSafety.heading: Account and Safety
accountSafety.q1: I forget my password. Wetin I go do?
accountSafety.a1: Click "Forgot Password" for login page. We go send reset link go your registered email address.
accountSafety.a2: Email sentinelxesports@gmail.com with di player username and details of di incident. For community posts, use di report button for di post.
accountSafety.q3: I feel say dem hack my account. Wetin I go do?
accountSafety.a3: Change your password sharp sharp using "Forgot Password" link for login page, then email us for sentinelxesports@gmail.com. We go lock di account and help you recover am.

howItWorks.title: How SentinelX Dey Work
howItWorks.subtitle: SentinelX na where Nigerian mobile gamers dey compete for organised tournaments, build their reputation, and win real prize money — all from their phone. Na dis one show you how to start.
howItWorks.metaDescription: From wen you create account to wen dem pay you — how Nigerian mobile gamers dey compete for SentinelX.
howItWorks.step1Body: Sign up with your email and choose username. Your username na your esports identity for di platform — pick something wey you go proud of. Your player profile go show your SX Score, win rate, achievements, and match history. Build am up tournament by tournament.
howItWorks.step2Body: Browse Tournaments page to find open registrations. Every tournament go show di game, entry fee, prize pool, format, and registration deadline. Pay di ₦500 entry fee with your card through Paystack. Or use SX Coins wey you don earn through competing — 1,000 coins go give you free entry.
howItWorks.step3Body: Once registration close, admin go generate di bracket. You go see your fixture (who you dey play and wetin time) for your Player Dashboard. You go also receive match reminder for WhatsApp if you don add your number for Settings.
howItWorks.step4Body: Play di match for di scheduled time. Keep am clean — no exploits, no rage quit. After di match: di winner take screenshot of di final score and record di match for their phone. You need both of dem for result submission.
howItWorks.step5Body: Go your Player Dashboard → My Matches → Submit Result. Upload your screenshot and screen recording. Admin go review di submission and confam di result. Di bracket go update only after admin confam — never before.
howItWorks.step6Body: Win your bracket and di prize money go enter your wallet. Link your Nigerian bank account and request withdrawal — money go arrive within 1–5 business days.
howItWorks.sxScoreBody: Every player start with SX Score of 700. Win matches, show up on time, and behave well — your score go increase. No-shows and disputes go bring am down. Your score dey determine your trust tier for di platform.
howItWorks.sxCoinsBody: You go earn SX Coins as you compete, complete weekly challenges, and unlock achievements. Spend am for entry fee discount, to boost your community posts, and for di in-platform store. Coins na wetin you earn — you no fit buy am with cash, and you no fit convert am to naira.
howItWorks.communityBody: Post for di community feed, react to match highlights, and take on weekly challenges. Di community dey public — anybody fit read am, but you need account before you fit post.
howItWorks.teamLeaguesBody: teams wey dey represent school or state, with team-vs-team standings.
